convention.ratio_blocks: R_D/S, the paper's Eq. (15): background- and (quasi)elastic-tail-subtracted tagged data over the normalised simulation, in the same (Q2, W*, p_s, cos theta_pq) bin. DIMENSIONLESS; a ratio of two tagged D(e,e'p_s)X yields, so per nucleus / per nucleon cancels. The simulation (Sec. IV C 1): plane-wave spectator model, the Paris deuteron wave function rescaled with the light-cone formalism of Frankfurt and Strikman, the struck neutron off shell with E = M_d - sqrt(M^2 + p_s^2), p = -p_s; Bosted-Christy F2n; Mo-Tsai radiative effects (RCSLACPOL); GEANT4 RTPC and GSIM CLAS; 'Our generator did not contain additional processes like coherent pion production, final-state interactions and other two-nucleon effects; therefore, the ratio of measured to simulated tagged data can be interpreted as a direct test of the spectator picture.' Normalisation (Sec. IV C 3): ONE factor N(p_s, E_b) per p_s bin and beam energy, fitted on -1 < cos theta_pq < -0.2 at W* = 2.0-2.2 GeV in the lowest fully accepted Q2 bin, common to every cos theta_pq and (W*, Q2) bin; its scale uncertainty +-10 % is NOT in the syst column. stat = statistical; syst = point-to-point systematic (Table I: 12.5 % in quadrature).
convention.ratio_bins: Block labels are bin centres: Q2 in GeV^2 (the file prints 'GeV/c,', sic) -- 0.93, 1.66, 3.38 are three of the paper's five Q2 centres (Sec. V A), the 1.66 bin is 1.10-2.23 GeV^2 (Figs. 10-13 captions); W* in GeV -- 1.17, 1.48, 1.73, 2.03, 2.44 are the mid-points of the paper's regions 1.0-1.35, 1.35-1.6, 1.6-1.85, 1.85-2.2, 2.2-2.68 GeV (Sec. V A; the quasi-elastic region 0.88-1.0 is not in the supplement); p_s in GeV/c -- 0.078, 0.093, 0.11, 0.135 the bins 70-85, 85-100, 100-120, 120-150 MeV/c; cos theta_pq -- ten even bins over [-1, 1], centres -0.9 ... 0.9. A row whose four columns all read 0 is a MISSING bin (kept verbatim), never a measured zero.
convention.dis_f2n_ratios: Ratio method (Sec. IV D), VIP region (p_s <= 100 MeV/c, theta_pq >~ 100 deg), the highest beam energy, integrated over Q2 > 1 GeV^2 per x bin, three lower W* cuts; per row the averages W*, Q2, x* and F2n/F2d, F2n/F2p with stat and syst. F2d is PER DEUTERON (F2n/F2d ~ r/(1 + r) with r = F2n/F2p, e.g. 0.7314/1.7314 = 0.4224 against the printed 0.4255). F2n/F2p = F2n/F2d times F2d/F2p of the collaboration's fit [69]; cross-normalised to the CJ fit at x = 0.32 (Fig. 21 caption), overall scale 7-10 % per beam energy not in syst. The supplement's header says 'see Fig. 20'; the three-cut F2n/F2p is the paper's Fig. 21.
